entities.name: Japanese destroyer Shirayuki
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Shirayuki  was the second of twenty-four Fubuki-class destroyers, built for the Imperial Japanese Navy following World War I. Shirayuki was sunk in the Battle of the Bismarck Sea on 3 March 1943 while under attack by American and Australian aircraft.
